pyqgis_plugin.name: Fillet & Chamfer for QGIS 3.x (Interactive & Batch)
pyqgis_plugin.description: Interactive Fillet, Chamfer, Two-Line Merge, Corner Restoration, CAD Rotation & Mirror suite for QGIS.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Comprehensive CAD editing suite providing interactive Fillet (corner rounding), Chamfer (corner beveling), Two-Line Fillet/Chamfer (Line Merge), Two-Edge Corner Restoration (Unfillet / Unchamfer), Interactive CAD Rotation, and CAD Mirror Tool for QGIS, along with an instant batch fillet and chamfer dock panel for selected vector features across QGIS 3.x and QGIS 4.x.
pyqgis_plugin.tags: cad, editing, fillet, chamfer, unfillet, corner, restore, rotate, rotation, mirror, symmetry, geometry, digitizing, curve, batch, merge, qgis4
pyqgis_plugin.change_log: 1.0.0.31: - Unified tab-order navigation, persistent keyboard focus, automatic text selection, and direct numeric keystroke redirection across Two-Line Fillet/Chamfer, Rotation, and Mirror tools. 1.0.0.30: - Fixed Two-Line Fillet/Chamfer to strictly clamp tangent and chamfer distances to selected segment endpoints, preventing overshoot and backwards loops in complex polylines. 1.0.0.29: - Fixed baseline guide line rendering and CRS handling in CAD Rotation Tool. 1.0.0.27: - Unified system snapping, numeric axis angle input, tab-order navigation, and focus text auto-selection in CAD Mirror and Rotation tools. 1.0.0.26: - Integrated interactive CAD 2-Point Mirror Tool with floating HUD, axis angle snap presets (Free, 15, 45, 90 Ortho), and duplicate copy mode. 1.0.0.25: - Positioned CAD Rotate tool action in 4th place on Advanced Digitize toolbar next to native Rotate Feature. 1.0.0.24: - Integrated interactive CAD 3-Point Rotation Tool with floating CAD HUD, angle snap presets, and duplicate copy mode into toolkit. 1.0.0.23: - Unified live preview color scheme with polygon tool: Blue (#2563EB) for Fillet and Emerald Green (#059669) for Chamfer. 1.0.0.22: - Implemented cyclic topological ring traversal for closed polylines, fixing corner seam doubling across all orientations (CW/CCW). 1.0.0.21: - Fixed topological chain assembly for intermediate polyline segments, preserving multi-point curve bends without 1D distortion. - Eliminated redundant intermediate endpoint vertices when lines are extended to the tangent touch points. - Disabled 'Remove feature from selection' button in QgsMergeAttributesDialog during Two-Line merge execution. 1.0.0.20: - Added direct eventFilter dialog result interception to guarantee feature creation after merge attribute confirmation even with default values. 1.0.0.19: - Fixed critical multipart geometry incompatibility error on singlepart line layers by using QgsMergeAttributesDialog. - Added automatic feature deletion of the second line and robust undoStack tracking upon merge confirmation. 1.0.0.18: - Guaranteed merged feature geometry application after confirming QGIS native Merge Selected Features dialog. - Added automatic clamping of fillet and chamfer to the physical line lengths to prevent overshoot on short segments. - Implemented full 2D cursor drag projection for Chamfer mode (supporting both synchronized linked and independent unlinked distances). 1.0.0.17: - Reused FilletCanvasWidget for Two-Line Fillet/Chamfer map tool with 3-step interactive cursor radius/chamfer drag. - Added on-canvas merge attribute checkbox and removed duplicate checkbox from batch dock panel. - Added safe cancellation handling for QGIS native Merge Features dialog to prevent unconfirmed layer changes. 1.0.0.16: - Fixed TypeError in toMapCoordinates conversion for intersection marker in Two-Line Fillet map tool. 1.0.0.15: - Added Two-Line Fillet and Chamfer CAD Map Tool with feature merging (mActionTwoLineFillet) for line vector layers. - Integrated CAD step-by-step HUD guidance and live rubberband intersection preview for two separate lines. - Support for native QGIS merge attributes dialog or direct attribute preservation based on user setting. - Full localization across 40 languages and cross-version support for QGIS 3.16 to 4.99. 1.0.0.14: - Fixed complete translation resolution across 40 languages for the batch settings dock panel. - Added dynamic auto-sizing and repositioning to Corner Restoration HUD panel to ensure hints are never clipped. 1.0.0.13: - Added floating CAD HUD step-by-step hints and step-back workflow for Two-Edge Corner Restoration (Unfillet / Unchamfer) tool. - Added auto-dismissal timers (4-5s duration) to all QGIS message bar notification strips. - Removed drop shadow effects from floating canvas widgets to match native QGIS flat CAD panel styling. - Pinned floating canvas HUD panels firmly to the top-right corner of the canvas. - Fixed English and non-Ukrainian UI translations for all CAD actions, toolbar buttons, tooltips, and canvas HUD widgets with QgsApplication.locale() discovery. 1.0.0.12: - Restricted numeric stepper inputs to digits only and normalized decimal separator (dot/comma) handling across canvas HUD and batch panel. - Added interactive CAD Two-Edge Corner Restoration tool (Unfillet / Unchamfer) with real-time intersection preview. - Dedicated toolbar button with custom QGIS delete-badge icon for corner reconstruction. - Added Batch Processing dock panel for instant Fillet and Chamfer on selected features in QGIS 3.x and QGIS 4.x. - Fixed all Qt6 / PyQt6 / QGIS 4.0 scoped enum compatibility issues. - Full CRS adaptation (metric meters and geographic degrees EPSG:4326). - Localized in 40 languages (all official QGIS GUI locales). 1.0.0.0: - Initial release of Fillet & Chamfer Tool for QGIS.
